title: Accuracy runs
intro: Check your bot against saved questions and compare results over time.
loadError: Could not load accuracy data. Try again.
error: Could not save this change. Check the selected questions, scoring expectations and active run, then try again.
caseLimit: Showing up to 500 saved questions. Editing or deleting a question preserves earlier run results.
question: Customer question
decline: The bot should decline or ask for human help
keywordHelp: One phrase per line, up to 20 phrases of 200 characters each. Every phrase must appear, ignoring letter case. Add a phrase, an expected source, or a decline expectation.
sourceHelp: Use the exact filename from Knowledge, or FAQ for a curated answer. This checks whether the source was retrieved; it does not verify the answer’s facts.
caseHelp: Use representative customer questions and explicit expectations. These are single-turn checks; no customer conversation or lead is created.
noCases: No test questions yet. An owner or admin can add questions to begin.
removePrompt: Delete this saved question? Earlier run snapshots and results will remain.
paidHelp: Each question may make billed embedding and model calls using the saved bot settings. Results stay in this workspace. One run can be active at a time.
approve: I approve the model calls for these selected questions.
active: A run is active. Wait for it to finish or cancel the remaining questions.
cancelPrompt: Stop the remaining questions? A model call already in progress may still be billed.
historyHelp: Latest 30 runs per page. Open a run to review its original expectations and answers. Compare like-for-like questions and knowledge; model or bot changes can affect scores.
trend: Pass rate, oldest to newest: completed runs on this page with the selected run’s saved test set. Exact dates and scores appear below.
noRuns: No accuracy runs yet. Select questions and start a run to save a baseline.
scoringHelp: Scores check literal phrases, expected citations and decline signals. They do not measure semantic accuracy. Provider errors count as non-passing cases; unfinished runs show partial scores. Saved answers may be shortened after 12,000 characters; checks use the full answer.
providerErrors: {count} questions had provider errors. Review them before comparing scores.
operationError: The provider could not complete this question. Check provider configuration and run it again.

errors.workspace_suspended: The workspace was suspended. Start a new run after access is restored.
errors.configuration_changed: Knowledge or retrieval settings changed during this run. Start a new run to keep the results consistent.
